chapter.title: Trading Commodities
chapter.summary: Buy commodities where they're cheap and sell where demand is higher.

objectives.title: Make your first trade run
objectives.why: Commodities bought at mining outposts, farms and stations sell for more where demand is higher. Your profit depends on the route.

steps.do: Pick a commodity and route that fits your ship's cargo grid (SCU). mobiOverlay's Commodity Prices and Trade Route Optimizer cards show live UEX prices.
steps.done_when: You know where to buy, where to sell and how much fits.

steps.do: Land legally at the buying location (request landing). If you don't, your ship won't appear at the trade terminal.
steps.done_when: Your ship is listed at the commodity terminal.

steps.do: Buy the commodity into your ship's cargo grid.
steps.done_when: The cargo shows in your ship.

steps.do: Fly to the selling location, land legally, and sell.
steps.done_when: The sale completes and your wallet goes up.

objectives.tips: Buy only what you can afford to lose: the cargo is yours until it's sold.

objectives.title: Sell hand-collected gems
objectives.why: Gems you collect by hand are ready to trade as they are; they don't need refining. Many on-foot commodities are found in and around caves.

steps.do: Collect gems by hand (caves are a good place to look).
steps.done_when: The gems are in your inventory.

steps.do: Land legally at a station or port with a commodity terminal and sell them.
